items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: And so I mean Rudy heard me and said that, and ever since then we've been like brothers.

ctx.x: Well now, I'm going to tell you a little story. When I went in the group I was -- I'll tell you about Rudy Powell. Rudy Powell played clarinet, played clarinet and alto saxophone (or) a lot of Fats' things. And I think

a lot of people looked on that knows is that him, you know, when they shouldn't have, because Rudy -- he's a great cat. Did some fine things, you know? When he came in the band, even Sedric was there, and he's sitting there playing, you know. Rudy made some arrangements --
